scripts.dev: npm run cf:resolve-config && wrangler dev --config wrangler.resolved.jsonc --env preview
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run cf:resolve-config && WRANGLER_LOG=error wrangler deploy --config wrangler.resolved.jsonc --env preview
scripts.deploy:production: npm run cf:resolve-config && WRANGLER_LOG=error wrangler deploy --config wrangler.resolved.jsonc --env production
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply REGISTRY_DB --local --env preview --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:preview: npm run cf:resolve-config && wrangler d1 migrations apply REGISTRY_DB --env preview --config wrangler.resolved.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:production: npm run cf:resolve-config && wrangler d1 migrations apply REGISTRY_DB --env production --config wrangler.resolved.jsonc
